name: Kyren
description: The goblin advisers of the Mercadian magistrate.

description_citations.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A revolution sweeps Mercadia City after the destruction of the Recreant.
timeline.quote: A revolution was then triggered that swept the city.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee comes to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren.
timeline.quote: the Dominarian goblin Squee would come to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard strikes a deal with the magistrate to train the Mercadian army and march on the Cho-Arrim to retrieve his ship.
timeline.quote: Gerrard proposes that he train the Mercadian army and then march them against their common enemy, the Cho-Arrim, to retrieve his ship.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara kills her father Starke before the Kyren, then reveals herself as Volrath.
timeline.quote: As the blood drains from Starke’s body, Takara metamorphoses into Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ramosans rebel against the Kyren and kill the Chief Magistrate and his advisors.
timeline.quote: They make their way towards the Magistrate’s Tower and attack and kill the Chief Magistrate and his Kyren advisors.
